reuse.why: Uses getBulkEditableCategories for category selection, getSheetValue/sheetForMonth for the spending, setBudget and batchMessages for writes, and the existing mutator(undoable(...)) registration.

duplication.why: The selection rule is shared; only the income/expense sign flip is written inline, mirroring the inline avg *= -1 in setNMonthAvg since the tree has no shared sign helper.

placement.why: The action sits beside setZero and the N-month averages in actions.ts and is registered next to the other budget methods in app.ts.

scope.why: Only the new action, its handler registration/type and a release note.

maintainability.why: Short, follows the established pattern of the sibling month-wide actions, so changes to the category rule propagate automatically.
